All item statements are link-free with immediate reference sections.

The run as a whole remains held outside this batch: the run-wide level check reports 166 empty scaffold inventories, none for batch 15. The live autopilot status reports 11/109 covered and an artifact-incomplete blocker for unit 58; owner reconciliation is still required.

The handoff and evidence are in the [batch-15 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-15.notes.md), [page inventory](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-15.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-15.proof-contracts.json), [coverage evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-15.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-15.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
